content.statement: The current returns policy specifies a 30-day full-refund window for standard items, so the claimed 30-day window is correct.
content.plan: Extracted the numeric return windows from the bundled policy artifacts, compared current v2 (30 days) with stale v1 (14 days) and the judge reference (14 days), computed the 16-day discrepancy and eligibility for the 10-day-old standard order; a two-sample t-test was not applicable because no n/mean/sd fields were provided.

evidence.inferential_test: not applicable: no two-group n/mean/sd data; deterministic policy comparison used
